title: Hi, how's life?
comment:
here are the reasons why you should stay alive on earth. even though there are so many people with mental disorders, anxiety, alienation, but believe me there will always be good things that you can hug and make you smile among all that. let's spread kindness to each other, do as much as you can. if you are getting tired of the world, rest your head for a moment, remember the good things around you and keep breathing consciously. you are great!

- Aliensicx (https://aliensicx.blogspot.com/2023/07/my-first-fanzine.html)
